panels.title: Monatlicher Traffic — Gesamte Historie
panels.description: Kein Zeitraum-Filter — alle Monate seit Aufzeichnungsbeginn für diesen Nutzer.

targets.query: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', time) AS time, SUM(bytes_in) AS "Bytes In", SUM(bytes_out) AS "Bytes Out" FROM openvpn_session WHERE common_name = '$cn' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', time) ORDER BY time
targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', time) AS time, SUM(bytes_in) AS "Bytes In", SUM(bytes_out) AS "Bytes Out" FROM openvpn_session WHERE common_name = '$cn' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Durchsatz im Zeitraum
panels.description: Delta aus kumulativen bytes_in/bytes_out. Negative Deltas (Reconnect) werden ausgeblendet.

targets.query: WITH ordered AS (SELECT time, bytes_in, bytes_out, LAG(bytes_in) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev_in, LAG(bytes_out) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev_out FROM openvpn_traffic WHERE common_name = '$cn' AND $__timeFilter(time)) SELECT time, CASE WHEN bytes_in >= prev_in THEN bytes_in - prev_in ELSE 0 END AS "Bytes In", CASE WHEN bytes_out >= prev_out THEN bytes_out - prev_out ELSE 0 END AS "Bytes Out" FROM ordered WHERE prev_in IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time
targets.rawSql: WITH ordered AS (SELECT time, bytes_in, bytes_out, LAG(bytes_in) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev_in, LAG(bytes_out) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev_out FROM openvpn_traffic WHERE common_name = '$cn' AND $__timeFilter(time)) SELECT time, CASE WHEN bytes_in >= prev_in THEN bytes_in - prev_in ELSE 0 END AS "Bytes In", CASE WHEN bytes_out >= prev_out THEN bytes_out - prev_out ELSE 0 END AS "Bytes Out" FROM ordered WHERE prev_in IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time

targets.query: SELECT real_ip AS "Real IP", COUNT(*) AS "Sessions", SUM(duration_s) AS "Gesamtdauer (s)", MAX(time) AS "Zuletzt gesehen" FROM openvpn_session WHERE common_name = '$cn' GROUP BY real_ip ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
targets.rawSql: SELECT real_ip AS "Real IP", COUNT(*) AS "Sessions", SUM(duration_s) AS "Gesamtdauer (s)", MAX(time) AS "Zuletzt gesehen" FROM openvpn_session WHERE common_name = '$cn' GROUP BY real_ip ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

targets.query: SELECT time AS "Disconnect", real_ip AS "Real IP", virtual_ip AS "VPN IP", duration_s AS "Dauer (s)", bytes_in AS "Bytes In", bytes_out AS "Bytes Out" FROM openvpn_session WHERE common_name = '$cn' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 100
targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "Disconnect", real_ip AS "Real IP", virtual_ip AS "VPN IP", duration_s AS "Dauer (s)", bytes_in AS "Bytes In", bytes_out AS "Bytes Out" FROM openvpn_session WHERE common_name = '$cn' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 100
